description: Defines the GroupLevel entity class representing hierarchical group levels in the system, including properties like parent ID, level name, and associated behaviors.

classes.name: GroupLevel
classes.description: Entity class modeling group hierarchy levels with attributes for parent linkage, name, and properties indicating super parent status, recursiveness, and client capability.

methods.name: GroupLevel
methods.description: Default constructor initializing properties to default values.

methods.name: GroupLevel
methods.description: Constructor to initialize a group level with specified properties.

methods.name: getParentId
methods.description: Returns the parent ID of the group level.

methods.name: getLevelName
methods.description: Returns the name of the level.

methods.name: isRecursable
methods.description: Checks if the level is recursable.

methods.name: canHaveClients
methods.description: Checks if the level can have clients.

methods.name: isSuperParent
methods.description: Checks if the level is marked as a super parent.

methods.name: isIdentifiedByParentId
methods.description: Determines if this level is identified by the specified parent ID.

methods.name: isCenter
methods.description: Checks if the level name is 'Center'.

methods.name: isGroup
methods.description: Checks if the level name is 'Group'.
